A0_full_system.description: Full VoiceMiner (SBERT + SVD-10d + K-Means + c-TF-IDF + Prior-Only Temporal + FDR + Stance)
A0_full_system.component_status: All components active with FDR significance control and stance verification.

A1_without_temporal.description: Static Volume and Sentiment Only (No growth rate or recentness window)
A1_without_temporal.measured_effect: Prioritization is entirely static-volume bound; high-growth emergent outages rank low until historical volume accumulates.

A2_without_semantic_embeddings.measured_effect: Silhouette dropped from 0.0384 to 0.0176 (-54.2% relative); cluster dispersion increased by +67.1%.

A3_without_sentiment.description: Uniform Sentiment Valence (No negative ratio prioritization)
A3_without_sentiment.measured_effect: Neutral operational questions compete directly with severe service complaints.

A4_without_statistical_filtering.description: Raw Association Co-occurrence vs Benjamini-Hochberg FDR Control
A4_without_statistical_filtering.measured_effect: Without FDR control, 3 candidate factors returned including non-significant noise; FDR filtering reduced false discovery set to 3 statistically supported factors.

A5_without_evidence_verification.description: Raw Semantic Retrieval vs Hypothesis-Conditioned Stance Classification
A5_without_evidence_verification.measured_effect: Hypothesis-aware stance classification successfully abstains on factor-unverified feedback, guarding against false support confirmation bias.

A6_without_dimensionality_reduction.description: Raw Sentence-BERT (384d) + K-Means without SVD reduction
A6_without_dimensionality_reduction.measured_effect: SVD 10d reduction improved silhouette score slightly (0.0347 -> 0.0384) while reducing vector storage by 97.4%.
